tools.name: get_property_overview
tools.description: Facts about The Galena Penthouse, a private top-floor one-bedroom penthouse in Aspen, Colorado, with ski-in access to Aspen Mountain: size, layout, sleeping capacity, location, highlights, honest caveats, ratings, permit and photos. Call this first to describe the property.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Night-by-night availability from the live booking calendar between two dates (up to 180 nights). Returns open windows, reserved ranges and whether the whole requested stay is open. Reserved nights are shown simply as reserved. Use get_quote to confirm the price and minimum stay for specific dates.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Exact all-in direct quote for specific dates from the live booking engine: itemized rent, any current offer, cleaning, property protection and taxes, with no platform fee. Also reports minimum-stay rules and invalid dates. Returns a prefilled secure checkout link for the guest. A quote is a live rat

tools.name: suggest_dates
tools.description: Lists open stay windows in a given month that fit the requested length and the typical minimum stay, with live all-in totals for the first few. Use it when the guest is flexible ("a long weekend in February").

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Check-in and check-out times, minimum age, maximum guests, pets, smoking, quiet hours, parking, housekeeping, typical minimum stays, taxes and how quotes and cancellations work, as stated in the official property listing.

tools.name: get_amenities
tools.description: Amenities by room and building (king bed, wood-burning fireplace, full kitchen, Sonos, pool and hot tub, ski locker), what is provided, and what is not available (no elevator, no central A/C, no daily maid service).

tools.name: get_location_and_nearby
tools.description: Address and coordinates plus walking times to lifts, restaurants, shops and transit, recurring Aspen events with their usual dates and live availability for those windows, and airport transfer times.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Rating summary and verbatim guest reviews from direct stays, newest first.

tools.name: compare_to_alternatives
tools.description: How The Galena Penthouse compares with luxury Aspen hotels (The Little Nell, St. Regis, Hotel Jerome, W Aspen) and with booking the same kind of stay on Airbnb or VRBO: space, kitchen, fireplace, ski access, pool and estimated hotel rates. Hotel figures are typical peak-season estimates, not quotes.
